title: Knowledge map metadata

drift.summary: The HTML map is useful as a visual artifact, but Wiki navigation and metadata now provide newer ways to inspect knowledge structure.
rationale: HTML knowledge maps can drift quickly from the physical docs tree.
The new Wiki tree now exposes real folders, file types, and metadata.
The map should either be regenerated or framed as illustrative.
